description: 2030 is the Year of the Metal Dog in the Chinese zodiac, from February 3, 2030 to January 22, 2031. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2030 is the Year of the Metal Dog, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 3, 2030 and ended on January 22, 2031, so people born in 2030 before Feb 3 belong to the Earth Rooster year.

sections.heading: 2030 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Metal Dog year on February 3, 2030, and the year ran to January 22, 2031. So a birth date of Feb 3, 2030 or later counts as Metal Dog, and so do early 2031 birthdays through Jan 22; births in 2030 before Feb 3 still belong to the Earth Rooster. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1970 are Metal Dog years too. That Sunday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Metal Dog is like
paragraphs: A guardian with an unbending code is the classic picture of this Dog year. With Earth feeding Metal, readings describe honest, disciplined protectors who will defend what is right at personal cost. Those born now make steadfast allies. Allowing shades of grey and expressing affection openly help their principles sit alongside compassion. Long hikes and disciplined training often suit their temperament, and close friends value their candour.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: 2030 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year reduces to 5, the number of change, freedom and movement, and a 5 year is usually described as restless and full of variety. The digits of 2030 add up to 5. The Dog holds the eleventh place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Earth. Set beside the year's Metal stem, earth generates Metal, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Earth Rooster and the year after is the Metal Pig.

Chinese almanacs name 2030 Geng-Xu, pairing the Metal stem Geng with the branch Xu. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2030?
faq.answer: 2030 is the Year of the Metal Dog. It started on February 3, 2030 and ended on January 22, 2031.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2030?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 3. Born before February 3, 2030, you are a Earth Rooster; born on or after it, you are a Metal Dog.

faq.question: What element is 2030 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Metal, a Yang year. The Dog's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2030?
faq.answer: Geng-Xu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Metal Dog year?
faq.answer: 2090, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1970.
